dse_decision: What does Merlin actually recover from a capture?
main_claim: Merlin recovers a loop/region/state contract (K, repeated ops, carried state, KV), not just op shapes.

dse_decision: Which DSE axes does the capture enable vs block?
main_claim: Recovered shapes/roles/K/KV vs erased low-bit vs not-claimed latency — fidelity gates the axes.
caveat: 'blocked/erased' is a capture limit, not a workload property

dse_decision: What does each capture level unlock?
main_claim: flat→high_level→quant_qdq progressively names attention/norm then low-bit.

dse_decision: Is one tiling primitive enough across workloads?
main_claim: One primitive is not robust; a 2-set reaches near-full worst-case coverage.
caveat: structural pad-waste coverage; not hardware performance

dse_decision: Is compute hot-op-dominated or diffuse?
main_claim: Workloads split into hot-op-dominated (few giant ops) vs diffuse regimes.
caveat: cumulative MAC share from IR shapes

dse_decision: How does weight traffic scale with the loop?
main_claim: Non-resident weight traffic grows ×K; residency loads once; dot = the model's IR K.
caveat: weight BYTES MOVED (not bandwidth); captured-config scale

dse_decision: When do repeated-head weights fit on-chip?
main_claim: dtype sets the residency budget: int4/int8 fit more workloads at a given on-chip capacity.

dse_decision: What weight bandwidth must a machine provide for 30 Hz?
main_claim: Residency lowers the required weight bandwidth to hit the target rate.
caveat: requirement floor under the workload model; not a chip measurement

dse_decision: How do system levers lower the 30 Hz requirement?
main_claim: Action chunking (/H) then residency (/K) each cut the required weight bandwidth.
caveat: requirement reduction (H,K from source/config); not a speedup

dse_decision: Which abstractions should DSE search first?
main_claim: A few abstractions are necessary across all workloads; others are workload-specific or blocked.

dse_decision: How does residency shift intensity across machine-balance regimes?
main_claim: Residency raises weight-stream AI, shifting workloads across a hypothetical balance band.
caveat: weight-stream AI; hypothetical balance; modeling view, not measured performance, not full-memory AI

dse_decision: How much recovered work is linear-GEMM vs attention?
main_claim: Most workloads are GEMM-geometry dominated; smolVLA is attention-heavy.

dse_decision: Linear-GEMM vs attention MAC mass per workload?
main_claim: Per-workload split of recovered linear vs attention MACs.

dse_decision: Deployment params/MACs scale per workload?
main_claim: Deployment magnitudes by config-composition (embed + per-layer × real n_layers).

dse_decision: What is the transfer cost of parallelism?
main_claim: Extra comm bytes per unit output rise with PU count; M broadcast > K reduction > N.
caveat: structural communication bytes; not a performance result

dse_decision: Absolute comm cost vs shard count?
main_claim: Absolute extra communication (GB) by axis × shard count.

dse_decision: Which top-MAC ops are expensive to shard?
main_claim: Sharding extra bytes for the top-MAC ops, normalized by output bytes.

dse_decision: MAC distribution across GEMM shape classes?
main_claim: Per-workload MAC split by shape class (square/skinny/...).

dse_decision: Is the primitive-set frontier robust to the pad-waste threshold?
main_claim: Worst-workload coverage vs set size across 5/10/20% thresholds.

dse_decision: Macro vs micro vs worst coverage by set size?
main_claim: Coverage measured three ways across set size.

dse_decision: Resident weight bytes per region by dtype?
main_claim: Resident weight bytes per region, int8 vs bf16.

dse_decision: Required compute vs replan deadline?
main_claim: Required GMAC/s as a function of deadline (a requirement).
caveat: requirement, not measured performance; configured K

dse_decision: Required weight bandwidth @100ms, resident vs reload?
main_claim: Residency removes a K× factor from the required weight bandwidth.

dse_decision: How much inter-op parallelism is available?
main_claim: work/span per workload (low ⇒ mostly serial chains; parallelism is intra-op).

dse_decision: Exact deployment magnitudes?
main_claim: Layers, params, MACs/token by config-composition; openVLA/tiny_llama are exact anchors.

dse_decision: Exact arithmetic intensity + residency gain?
main_claim: Weight-stream AI resident vs reload + residency gain per workload.
caveat: weight-stream (modeling) AI, not full-memory; not measured performance

dse_decision: Low-bit tier per workload?
main_claim: native/qdq_int8/dequant_only per workload; int8 ratified by the measured gate.

dse_decision: Exact real-time requirement per regime?
main_claim: Required compute + weight bandwidth per VLA/VLM regime.

dse_decision: What missing measurement unblocks the most candidates?
main_claim: Ranks missing measurements by how many abstraction candidates they unblock.

dse_decision: How stable are corpus metrics to leave-one-out?
main_claim: Leave-one-out stability of corpus metrics (winner-stable vs magnitude-unstable).

dse_decision: Provenance mix of facts per workload?
main_claim: Fact counts by evidence tier per workload.

dse_decision: Provenance mix of facts per phase?
main_claim: Fact counts by evidence tier per analysis phase.

dse_decision: Required dispatch/s vs deadline?
main_claim: Required dispatch rate (a PROXY).

dse_decision: Per-primitive mean vs worst coverage?
main_claim: Redundant with primitive_set_frontier / decision_primitive_choice.
